dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two visible horizontal bands; the lower band across greater coverts is high-contrast, thick, and bright white, while the upper band across median coverts is thinner and less distinct.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent, sharp pale-yellowish to white margins visible along the outer webs of folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: An irregular, high-contrast white rectangular patch is clearly visible on the central posterior nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct color transition from dark grey/black on the crown to olive-green on the mantle, interrupted by the white nape patch.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a conspicuous white patch on the nape contrasting sharply with the surrounding dark crown and olive-green mantle.
